example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি কী আবোল-তাবোল বকছো? স্পষ্ট করে বলো।
সভায় তার আবোল-তাবোল কথা শুনে সবাই হাসতে লাগল।
example_sentences_in_english: What gibberish are you talking? Speak clearly.
Everyone started laughing hearing his nonsensical ramblings in the meeting.
note: This idiom uses playful, invented words to mimic senseless speech, common in colloquial Bengali.
